title: How writ executed.
bodyText: The officer to whom the writ for delivering possession is directed and delivered shall execute the same according to the tenor thereof.
bodyHtml: §666-12  How writ executed.  The officer to whom the writ for delivering possession is directed and delivered shall execute the same according to the tenor thereof. [CC 1859, §944; RL 1925, §2785; RL 1935, §4022; RL 1945, §10411; RL 1955, §240-12; HRS §666-12]
